mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the total amount spent on new capital assets in a year."

Investment is the addition to existing stock of capital and therefore it is a flow concept.

Inflation is a highly controversial term which has undergone modification since it was defined by the neo-classical economists.

The GDP of a country is defined as the market value of all final goods and services produced within a country (by both nationals and foreigners) in a given period of time.

Explaining and preventing these fluctuations is one of the main focuses of macroeconomics.

Economic growth theory typically refers to growth of potential output which is caused by growth in aggregate demand.
